# @smogon/calc 0.12.0 (vendored)

Pokémon Showdown's damage calculator engine, by Smogon contributors (MIT, see LICENSE).

- `data.min.js` = `dist/data/production.min.js`, `calc.min.js` = `dist/production.min.js` from the npm package `@smogon/calc@0.12.0`, unmodified.
- Load `data.min.js` first; together they define `window.calc`.
- Source: https://github.com/smogon/damage-calc · Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@smogon/calc

To update: download both files for the new version from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@smogon/calc@VERSION/dist/, replace these, and run the tests.
